name: Hachijou Ikuko
source: Hachijou Ikuko is the mystery novelist who fabricated stories about the Rokkenjima murders along with her partner Hachijou Tooya. [spoiler]She was the person who found Battler after he was passed out on a highway. She had taken him in and gave him the name Tooya.[/spoiler]
